d:
Govinda vaghmare, jo apni niyantrit patni ke sath phansa huaa hai, apni khubsurat premika se pyar chahta hai jo use ek arajak sthiti men le jati hai.
Govinda Waghmare, who is stuck with his controlling wife, seeks love from his gorgeous girlfriend which leads him into a chaotic situation.
Movie Name: Govinda Naam Mera
StarCast: Vicky Kaushal, Bhumi Pednekar & Kiara Advani
Director: Shashank Khaitan
Kahani ek, tvist aur tarn anek! kya govinda apni sabhi samasyaon ka samadhan kar paenge? ek hatya, kuchh rahasy, dher sara romanch aur masala ki garanti!
Philm ka nam: govinda nam mera
